item.title: NOAH Property Management names Chris Cloud as CEO
item.description: NOAH Property Management appointed Chris Cloud as CEO, succeeding founder Matt Foster, as the company expands affordable housing management across the Upstate. The post NOAH Property Management names Chris Cloud as CEO appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: The Archer names Taylor Piedfort executive chef
item.description: Charleston restaurant The Archer promoted Taylor Piedfort to executive chef, with plans for new seasonal menu items and expanded culinary programming. The post The Archer names Taylor Piedfort executive chef appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Publix to anchor Powdersville Plaza redevelopment
item.description: Publix will anchor a redevelopment of Powdersville Plaza, adding a new 48,000-square-foot store and upgrades to the Anderson County shopping center. The post Publix to anchor Powdersville Plaza redevelopment appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Fayat Group distribution center completed in Ridgeway
item.description: Fayat Group opens a 100,000-square-foot distribution center in Ridgeway built by Cohn Construction, supporting growth and 75 new jobs in Fairfield County. The post Fayat Group distribution center completed in Ridgeway appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Nova at One Nexton apartments break ground in Summerville
item.description: The Collier Companies broke ground on Nova at One Nexton, a 360-unit luxury apartment community in Summerville’s Nexton development with resort-style amenities. The post Nova at One Nexton apartments break ground in Summerville appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: HOT PROPERTIES: SC Golf Association finds a home
item.description: Hot Properties roundup highlights commercial real estate deals across South Carolina, including sales, leases and development activity statewide. The post HOT PROPERTIES: SC Golf Association finds a home appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: VIP Marketing and Craft Creative win three Golden Gavel Awards in Miami Beach
item.description: VIP Marketing and its premium video production subsidiary, Craft Creative, recently announced they earned three Golden Gavel Awards at the 2026 Golden Gavel Awards ceremony during the Trial Lawyers Summit in Miami Beach, Florida. The post VIP Marketing and Craft Creative win three Golden Gavel Awards in Miami Beach appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Precast manufacturer invests $9M in first SC operations in Clinton
item.description: Coastal Precast Systems will invest $9 million in Laurens County to open a Clinton facility, creating 70 jobs to support Southeast infrastructure projects. The post Precast manufacturer invests $9M in first SC operations in Clinton appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Salthouse opens 14,000-square-foot Charleston commissary
item.description: Salthouse Catering opens a 14,000-square-foot commissary kitchen in Charleston, offering flexible leases and commercial space for food trucks, caterers and CPG brands. The post Salthouse opens 14,000-square-foot Charleston commissary appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: DP3 Architects launches dedicated commercial studio
item.description: DP3 Architects has launched a dedicated Commercial Studio to support retail, workplace, mixed-use, and other commercial development projects across the Southeast. The post DP3 Architects launches dedicated commercial studio appeared first on SCBiz.
